paite: Huaiziak in Pathian zahngaihna a hiai nasepna mu in ka lungke kei uhi.
heading: Leibel Ah Vangou Kem

paite: Thil zumhuai kiselte ka pampaih zawta ua, khemna thu ka zang kei ua, Pathian thu tuh mi khemna ding in ka zang kei ua, thutak theisak in Pathian mitmuh in michih sia-le-pha theihna mit ka tungsak uhi.
Himahleh ka tanchinhoih uh khuh a a-omleh, mangthang lelte ah ahi khuh a a-om.
Pathian batpih Khrist leh athupidan tanchinhoih vak in amau asalhvak theihlouhna ding in, huaite ah hiai khovel pathian in agingtaloute lungsim asukmialsakta hi.
Koumau thu ka gen kei ua, Khrist Jesu Toupa thu ka gen zaw uhi, koute leng Jesu ziak in sikha ka hih uh leng ka gen zel uhi.
Jesu Khrist mel ah Pathian thupidan theihna vak hon pe ding in, "Mial a kipan vak avakkhe ding," chipa Pathian in i lungtangte asalvakta ngal hi.
Himahleh thilhihtheihna thupina koute a hilou a, Pathian a ahihtheih zawkna ding in huai gou tuh leibel ah ka kem uhi.
Alanglang ah nehden in ka om ua, himahleh ning kitel in ka om tuan kei uh; mangbang in ka om ua himahleh ka lungke tuan kei uhi.
heading: Khrist A Pathian Hatna

paite: Sawi in ka om ua, himahleh taisan in ka om kei uh; khetpuk in ka om ua, himahleh hihmang in ka om kei uh.
Ka pumpi uah chik lai peuh in leng Jesu sihna ka pu zel ua, Jesu hinna leng ka pumpi ua alattheihna ding in.
Koute hingdam a omlaite Jesu ziak a si ding a matsak in ka om gige ua Jesu hinna leng ka sa sithei ua a lattheihna ding in.
Huchi in koute ah sihna in asem gige a, nou ah bel hinna in asem gige hi.
Himahleh, "Ka ging a, huaiziak in thu ka gen ahi," chih gelhpa ginna lungsim ngei pu in, kou leng ka ging ua, thu leng ka gen uhi.
Toupa Jesu kaithoupa'n koute leng Jesu ah hon kaithou sam ding a, noumau toh ama omna mun ah hon dingsak ding chih thei in.
Bangkim noumau hoihna ding ahi ngal a, hehpihna mi tamzaw ziak a hihkhan a om a, Pathian thupina ding a kipahthu genna nakpitak a akhansak sem theihna ding in.
Huai thu ziak in ka bah kei uhi; i polam mihing zawngkhal hiaihiai mahleh, i sunglam mihing pen niteng in bawl thak zel in a-om zaw ahi.
heading: Pumpi Khat A Hinna Nih

paite: Ka gimthuakna neukha uh tu mitphiat kal sung kia a om ding in, thupina thupitak tangtawn a ding in ahon bawlsak hulhul ahi.
Thil muhtheihte en lou in, thil muh theihlouhte ka en zaw uhi; thil muhtheihte zaw sawt lou kal a ding ahi a, thil muh theihlouhte bel tangtawn a ding ahi zaw hi.
